deviations.what: c3/S15 'App lock · waiting for fingerprint · Android', 'Fingerprint not recognised · Android' and c1/S15.3 'Enter PIN · Fingerprint above the boxes · Android' (the __android360 captures): the fingerprint glyph is Material's Icons.fingerprint — closed concentric whorls — where the frames draw a lighter open-stroke fingerprint
deviations.reason: [shared] No drawn fingerprint glyph exists in the app (FaceIdGlyph paints only the face); the capture helper allows Material Icons, so the platform icon stands in until a painted fingerprint joins face_id_glyph.dart
deviations.authority: ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (frames decide icons) — open item, WORDS179

deviations.what: Production (not the captures): on a real phone the method is named neutrally — 'Fingerprint or face', with the platform's glyph — because no seam yet reports which biometric is enrolled; the captures inject it (iPhone face → Face ID, Android fingerprint → Fingerprint) as the frames draw
deviations.reason: [screen] ⚠️ SPEC biometric_kind.dart: the keystore channel (features/devices + native halves) has no modality query, and guessing would break the 🔒 ruling on some phones (a Touch ID iPhone told Face ID). KeystoreBiometricGate.modality / ColdStartGate.modality are the seam for bootstrap to wire

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 'Enter PIN · Face ID above the boxes · iPhone', 'Wrong PIN · tries remaining · iPhone' and the c1b twins (S15.3__default, S15.3__wrong-pin): laid out from the top with the tiled keypad above 'Forgot PIN'; the frames centre the column and draw no keypad
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] The boxes need an input surface or the state is a dead end; c3/S15 'PIN instead · six digits' draws this same state with the in-app keypad, and one shared PinKeypad keeps S15, S15.3 and S0.8 from drifting. A system keyboard would also expose the PIN to third-party keyboards
deviations.authority: 07 §1 rule 6 🔒 (no dead ends); c3/S15 'PIN instead · six digits'; PLAN desk 155

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 'Enter PIN · Face ID above the boxes · iPhone' (S15.3__default): the next empty box is edged in primary; the c1/c1b frames do not draw it (c3 does)
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] Same state drawn two ways; the c3 focus cue is kept as the visible-focus aid

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 'Enter PIN' / 'Wrong PIN' (S15.3__default, S15.3__wrong-pin): the sealed mark draws at 48 px where the c1 frames draw 52 px; titles draw at 20 px (section role) where the frames draw ~17–18 px
deviations.reason: [screen] Built to c3/S15 'PIN instead · six digits' (48 px mark), since one widget state cannot carry both sizes; the title follows the type-role rule ([shared] type scale)

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 'Wrong PIN · tries remaining · iPhone' (S15.3__wrong-pin): '2 tries left before you'll need a code on your number' is drawn with a straight apostrophe where the frame sets ’, and the line sits ~30 px under the boxes where the frame leaves ~43 px; c1/S15.3 'Forgot PIN · a code, not a lockout' (S15.3__forgot-pin): 'We'll send a code…' likewise straight where the frame sets ’
deviations.reason: [screen] ARB copy in lock_en.arb (lock.pin.tries_left, lock.forgot.body) uses U+0027 where the canvas sets U+2019 (as auth_en.arb already does, e.g. update.offline). The tighter spacing follows the keypad layout above

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 and c1b/S15.3 'Forgot PIN · a code, not a lockout' (S15.3__forgot-pin): no field showing the registered number '+91 98765 43210'
deviations.reason: [screen] The lock mounts before any session (cold_start_gate.dart) and LockScope carries no number; inventing one is worse than leaving it out. ⚠️ SPEC at _ForgotPage

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 'Forgot PIN · a code, not a lockout' (S15.3__forgot-pin): the filled 'Send the code' button carries the theme's rounded corners (radius.md 8) and sits inset from the edges where the frame draws it square-cornered
deviations.reason: [shared] FilledButton theme (app/lib/shared/theme.dart filledButtonTheme, tokens radius.md). The canvases disagree among themselves (c1b L1/L2/L8 draw it rounded; c1 S15.3 and c3 S19.1 draw it square), so the shared component needs one ruling
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart filledButtonTheme; tokens.json radius.md (phase 2 shared component)

deviations.what: c1/S15.3 'Forgot PIN · a code, not a lockout' body (takes three lines on Android where the frame takes two): body copy draws with Material's inherited tracking at 16 px where the canvas sets 15.5 px untracked, so lines break a word or two earlier than the frame
deviations.reason: [shared] rkTextTheme (app/lib/shared/theme.dart). No token defines tracking and RkType.body sets none, so ThemeData merges the M3 defaults (bodyLarge 0.5 px, bodyMedium 0.25 px); one line in rkTextTheme (letterSpacing: 0) fixes every screen. 15.5 px maps to the body role (16) by rule
deviations.authority: app/lib/shared/theme.dart rkTextTheme (phase 2 shared component); ADR 2026-10-05 §1 (tokens decide values: typography.scale.body 16)

deviations.what: No frame: PIN-only phone — the forgot page says the recovery-ladder copy (lock.forgot.body_pin_only) and the tries row says 'before the PIN switches off'
deviations.reason: [screen] A code to the number alone is not the reset on a phone with no biometric (desk 147); conservative reading

deviations.what: No frame: gate invalidated — in the app (S15.3__forgot-reenrolled) the body says the face or fingerprint settings changed and the one action is 'Prove it's you' (S11 ladder); at cold start (S15.3__forgot-reenrolled-before-open) the body says only the PIN opens the app, with no action button
deviations.reason: [screen] A changed biometric set cannot be the reset (06 §4.4); before the app is composed no ladder entry exists, and a button that does nothing is a dead end. Nearest frame c1/S15.3 'Forgot PIN · a code, not a lockout'

deviations.what: c1b/U3 'Forgot PIN · enter the code' (S15.3__forgot-send-code-lands): 'Send the code' opens S0.2 at its number step — 'Your phone number', the I'm-new subtitle, an empty field and a disabled 'Send code', with no back chevron — where the frame shows the code step ('Enter the code', 'Sent by SMS to +91 98765 43210.', boxes, 'Send again in 0:24') with a back chevron
deviations.reason: [screen] Only the reset's first step exists: the forgot door pushes the S0.2 route because the lock holds no number and the reverification flow is not built (⚠️ SPEC main.dart _onForgotPin). The missing chevron leaves iOS with only the edge-swipe back — flagged as an open item against 07 §1 rule 6

deviations.what: c1b/U3b 'Forgot PIN · confirm it's you': not built — no step where, after the code, the biometric confirms the person ('The code proved the number. Face ID proves it is you holding this phone.', the system sheet, 'Cancel')
deviations.reason: [screen] The reset's biometric step is not built (same ⚠️ SPEC as above)

deviations.what: c1b/U4 'Set a new PIN': not reached — the reset never arrives at 'Choose a new PIN' (six boxes, 'Six digits. You'll type it twice.', keypad); S0.8's set-PIN screen exists but nothing links the forgot flow to it
deviations.reason: [screen] Same open reset flow; S0.8 is owned by onboarding

deviations.what: c3/S15 'PIN instead · six digits' and c1/S15.3 'Enter PIN' frames (S15__pin-instead, S15.3__default): the six PIN boxes draw smaller and closer together — about 43 px wide with ~9 px gaps and slightly shorter, where the frames draw ~46 px boxes with ~11 px gaps
deviations.reason: [shared] PIN box row (the same component on S0.8, S15, S15.3): box size and gap come from the shared widget, not the screen
